text:
maria: Quick sweep idea — let's clean up the starter app auth UX in the quickstart. confusing env var names and a couple of outdated SDK snippets. anyone free to pair on the PR? :wave:

alex: I can start a PR with the snippet changes. planning to rename REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_API_TOKEN (more explicit). will add a deprecation note.

sam: thanks — can you also update the sample app deploy steps? the deploy guide still references the old env var in the Dockerfile.

maria: yep that's the plan. aim is: minimal breaking for existing users, clear migration path, and one-line fix in the starter app.

katy: quick question: do we need to change SDK examples too? current quickstart shows `Client(api_key=...)`.

alex: good catch. change examples to the new param name `token`. e.g.:

```
from redwood import Client
import os
client = Client(token=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_TOKEN"))
```

Also add a tiny note about `os.getenv` vs `os.environ` for first-time Python folks.

sam: I'll update the Dockerfile snippet to `ENV REDWOOD_API_TOKEN=...` and the deploy docs. trying to keep changes scoped to: quickstart, starter app repo, and the migration guide page.

ryan: are we going to keep a compatibility shim in the SDK so old env var still works for one release? would reduce churn for customers on pinned images.

alex: I can add a shim: look for REDWOOD_API_TOKEN, fallback to REDWOOD_API_KEY, and log a deprecation warning at import time. then remove the fallback after one release cycle.

katy: sounds good. small ask: add a line in the quickstart that shows how to set secret in CI (GH Actions example). folks always miss that.

maria: agreed — GH Actions snippet like: `- name: Set REDWOOD token
  run: echo "REDWOOD_API_TOKEN=${{ secrets.REDWOOD_API_TOKEN }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV` (we'll format properly in the doc).

alex: opened draft PR: https://git.redwood/example/PR-432 (WIP). added tests for snippet render and a CI smoke check to ensure the starter app builds with the new ENV. doc-bot: can you post CI status?

doc-bot: PR 432 -> CI: failed (flake in example test). see logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/432

sam: I see the flake — test expecting `REDWOOD_API_KEY` in rendered HTML. pushing a fix to the test to accept either key for now.

maria: timeline — let's aim to merge by EOD Thursday. alex will keep the shim in SDK for 1 release. katy will add GH Actions snippet. sam will update Dockerfile and deploy steps. I'll do final content review and schedule a quick announcement in #announcements.

ryan: also let's add a tiny migration note in the console (tooltip) if possible. low priority but helps users.

alex: noted. I'll add a TODO in the PR for product to follow up on the console tooltip.

maria: perfect. if anyone hits blockers ping me here or DM. thanks team! :heart:
